scoring_justification: Cannot recompute d_m without the original zeolite dataset and re-running the full GRNN/RBF training pipeline; comparing agent's reported d_m to paper's reported values with threshold_or_better tolerance is the feasible fallback.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference d_m values for GRNN and RBF from Table 1 of the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1: Average relative errors d_m (%) for GRNN and RBF methods
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual published results, used to verify that the agent's reproduced model achieves comparable or better performance.

outputs.description: Table of average relative errors (d_m in %) for GRNN and RBF predictions of six zeolite structural parameters from XRD peak angles.

output_contract.notes: Only the d_m values for GRNN and RBF are scored. Multilinear regression baseline and halved-training-data analysis are excluded per scope.

steps.description: Compare agent's reported d_m values to paper's gold: full credit for each entry if agent d_m ≤ reference + 2.0 else 0; final score = fraction of 12 entries passing.
